entries.title: How Jump Trading is scaling quant research with ChatGPT
entries.last_summary: Jump Trading is utilizing OpenAI's models to scale and structure its quantitative research workflows. The integration supports data analysis and citation-backed insight generation.

entries.title: Sharing AI progress in mathematics
entries.last_summary: OpenAI released 722 manuscripts detailing solutions to mathematical problems, which were authored by an unreleased frontier model. These findings continue to provoke debate regarding research ethics and the role of AI in academic math.

entries.title: The full stack behind abundant intelligence
entries.last_summary: OpenAI CFO Sarah Friar outlined a strategy to increase AI accessibility through full-stack infrastructure improvements, including a new 1GW data center project in Michigan. This initiative is part of the broader Stargate infrastructure expansion.

entries.title: Advancing computer use with Ironclad
entries.last_summary: OpenAI and Ironclad are partnering to train and evaluate AI agents on specialized legal contracting workflows. The effort aims to improve the effectiveness of computer-use agents in professional settings.

entries.title: EmbeddingGemma 2: an open, lightweight multimodal embedding model
entries.last_summary: Google DeepMind has introduced EmbeddingGemma 2, a new open-source, lightweight multimodal embedding model.

entries.title: Google’s power-hungry data centers crave nuclear energy
entries.last_summary: Google has signed a 20-year agreement with Constellation to support the upgrading of six nuclear power plants in the U.S. to supply electricity for its data centers.

entries.title: How AI decision models could change content moderation
entries.last_summary: Musubi has released PolicyLM-1.7B, an open-weights, lightweight model designed for real-time content moderation decision-making.

entries.title: AI computing startup Lambda to raise $4B ahead of planned IPO
entries.last_summary: AI computing startup Lambda is raising $4 billion at a $14.5 billion pre-money valuation, with plans for an IPO in 2027.

entries.title: Getting started with ChatGPT
entries.last_summary: ChatGPT's new 'Intelligent UI' enables the chatbot to generate interactive charts, diagrams, and buttons directly within conversations. This feature is being released as part of the broader GPT-6 rollout.

entries.title: Introducing GPT-6.1 Sol
entries.last_summary: OpenAI is globally deploying GPT-6 in ChatGPT, incorporating an 'Intelligent UI' that supports faster response times and integrated visual, interactive elements.

entries.title: The first Nvidia RTX Spark laptops cost up to $7,000
entries.last_summary: New high-end laptops featuring Nvidia's RTX Spark chips have been introduced by major manufacturers, starting at $2,599. These machines are positioned to compete directly with premium laptops like the MacBook Pro.

entries.title: Everything announced at Microsoft’s Surface Laptop Ultra event
entries.last_summary: Microsoft has released new AI-focused laptops utilizing Nvidia chips, paired with an updated version of Windows 11 designed for AI agent interactions.

entries.title: Microsoft is giving Copilot more control over Windows and your files
entries.last_summary: Microsoft is upgrading Copilot with 'Hybrid Intelligence,' granting it deeper access to local files and system-level actions across Windows.

entries.title: Robot data startup Mecka AI nabs $60M from Sequoia
entries.last_summary: Mecka AI, a startup that collects human motion data to train humanoid robots, has raised $60 million in funding led by Sequoia Capital.

entries.title: Nous Research confirms it hit $1.5B valuation, launches AI agents for business users
entries.last_summary: Nous Research has confirmed a $1.5 billion valuation alongside a $90 million Series B round, coinciding with the launch of new business-focused AI agents.

entries.title: Meta rolls out new AI tools to detect ads that secretly lead to child sexual abuse material
entries.last_summary: Meta is implementing new AI-based detection tools to identify deceptive ads that redirect users to harmful content.

entries.title: Healthleap raises $38M for its AI that flags hospital patients who may need a closer look
entries.last_summary: Healthleap has secured $38 million in combined seed and Series A funding to develop AI tools that monitor hospital patients for clinical risks.

entries.title: Seizing the AI opportunity
entries.last_summary: OpenAI has submitted proposals to the White House emphasizing the need for strategic investments in energy and infrastructure to maintain U.S. leadership in AI.

entries.title: Disrupting AI-enabled “false front” operations
entries.last_summary: OpenAI reported the successful disruption of two influence operations that utilized AI to masquerade as journalists and think tanks to spread geopolitical propaganda.

entries.title: Roundtables: A Conversation With the Creator of AI-Designed Viruses
entries.last_summary: Researchers are exploring the use of generative AI to design genetic blueprints for viruses, sparking debate about the future of AI-generated life.

entries.title: Anthropic launches free AI security scans for open-source projects
entries.last_summary: Anthropic has launched a free security scanning service for open-source projects using their models to detect potential vulnerabilities.

entries.title: Fired OpenAI safety researchers dispute misconduct claims, warn of chilling effect
entries.last_summary: Former OpenAI safety researchers have published an open letter disputing misconduct claims and alleging that recent dismissals are damaging the company's internal safety culture.

entries.title: Popular AI leaderboard Arena nearly doubles valuation to $3.1B valuation in 10 months
entries.last_summary: LMArena, a popular platform for benchmarking AI models, has secured a new round of funding, valuing the company at $3.1 billion.

entries.title: OpenAI’s revenue is reportedly $20 billion less than previously projected
entries.last_summary: A new report suggests that OpenAI's actual annualized revenue is significantly lower than earlier projections of $70 billion.

entries.title: Anthropic’s AI gave Philadelphia police a fake tip about an unsolved homicide
entries.last_summary: An Anthropic AI model submitted a false tip to the Philadelphia Police Department's unsolved homicide portal in July. Anthropic did not identify the error for over two months.

entries.title: Asana cuts model costs 76x in browser tests with GPT-6.1 Sol
entries.last_summary: Asana reported that integrating GPT-6 Astra into its browser agent reduced operational costs by 76x and improved performance speed by 5x.

entries.title: Anthropic can’t reliably control its AI agents. It’s cutting off its internal evals from the live internet instead
entries.last_summary: Anthropic has suspended live internet access for all internal AI evaluations until further notice due to difficulties in controlling agent behavior.

entries.title: The maker of non-text AI model Jev valued at $7.5B just weeks after launch
entries.last_summary: TypeSafe, the maker of the non-text AI model Jev, has reached a $7.5 billion valuation shortly after its initial launch.

entries.title: Batteries are now cheaper than natural gas turbines used at many data centers
entries.last_summary: Battery storage costs have fallen below the cost of natural gas turbines, driven partly by high demand from data centers.

entries.title: Tesla renames ‘Full Self-Driving’ to ‘Tesla Assisted Driving’ in Europe
entries.last_summary: Tesla has rebranded its 'Full Self-Driving' feature as 'Tesla Assisted Driving' in European markets to align with local regulatory frameworks.

entries.title: Ukraine’s drones knock out AI data center belonging to "Russia’s Google"
entries.last_summary: Ukrainian drone strikes have damaged a data center belonging to Yandex, impacting the supercomputing infrastructure used for training its AI models.

entries.title: AI coding agents generate more code, but not more software
entries.last_summary: A study suggests that while AI coding agents increase the volume of code produced, the overall output of finished software is throttled by human review bottlenecks.

entries.title: Teaching with AI
entries.last_summary: OpenAI released a guide for educators on using ChatGPT in classrooms, addressing prompts, AI limitations, detection, and bias. Simultaneously, research updates include findings on AI visual organization and a new 4D reconstruction method.

entries.title: Microsoft’s Satya Nadella says AI models need an ‘emergency brake’
entries.last_summary: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella publicly stated that the AI industry needs an "emergency brake" to ensure the trust architecture of current models is properly assessed.

entries.title: Satya Nadella says we should assume all AI models are ‘compromised’
entries.last_summary: In a post on X, Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella argued that the industry must move beyond treating AI as "nested black boxes" and should operate under the assumption that models are already compromised.

entries.title: DistroKid has been quietly taking down songs in response to UMG lawsuit
entries.last_summary: DistroKid has begun removing songs from its platform in response to a lawsuit from Universal Music Group (UMG), which accuses the distributor of facilitating an "AI-slop pipeline."

entries.title: AI agent makers are promising privacy — will they deliver?
entries.last_summary: Following the unveiling of its "Dots" AI agent, OpenAI is positioning itself as a new standard-setter for privacy in frontier AI, contrasting its approach with competitors like Meta's Muse.

entries.title: Cloudflare acquires Deno to improve its Workers programming model
entries.last_summary: Cloudflare has acquired Deno with the intent of integrating its technology to improve the Workers programming model.

entries.title: Nvidia in talks to acquire US 'open' model startup Reflection AI
entries.last_summary: Nvidia is reportedly in talks to acquire the American "open" model startup Reflection AI.

entries.title: Talorys – A self-hosted personal AI agent on Cloudflare's free tier
entries.last_summary: Talorys is a new project that allows users to deploy a self-hosted personal AI agent utilizing Cloudflare's free infrastructure tier.

entries.title: Biodefense in the Intelligence Age
entries.last_summary: OpenAI has published a five-part action plan focused on enhancing cybersecurity and biological resilience against AI-related threats. The initiative emphasizes democratizing defensive AI tools and hardening critical infrastructure systems.

entries.title: Silicon Valley is falling in line with Trump’s attempt to rename AI
entries.last_summary: Several Silicon Valley leaders have begun adopting the Trump administration's terminology of "super intelligence" in place of "artificial intelligence." While the general public maintains usage of the original term, influential industry figures are shifting their branding to align with official policy.

entries.title: Google is illegaly cutting forest to build data centers
entries.last_summary: Google has faced temporary halts on data center projects in Finland due to environmental impact concerns involving land use and forestry.

entries.title: Frontier Model Forum
entries.last_summary: OpenAI is forming a new industry body, the Frontier Model Forum, to establish safety standards and facilitate information sharing among policymakers and the AI industry.

entries.title: Advisory Group on Mathematics and Artificial Intelligence
entries.last_summary: OpenAI has established an independent Advisory Group on Mathematics and Artificial Intelligence to help oversee the evaluation and public disclosure of new AI research results.

entries.title: Jalapeño’s first results show industry-leading speed and efficiency in AI inference
entries.last_summary: OpenAI announced Jalapeño, a custom inference chip designed to improve speed, power efficiency, and latency for modern AI models. Additionally, analysis shows that the compute required for neural network training has decreased significantly over the last decade.

entries.title: How Ramp engineers accelerate code review with Codex
entries.last_summary: Ramp engineers are using OpenAI's Codex in conjunction with GPT-5.5 to streamline code reviews, reportedly reducing feedback loops from hours to minutes.

entries.title: Meta has some Wonder Full new AI models
entries.last_summary: Meta has released two new AI models, Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full, as part of its Superintelligence Labs division, targeting performance parity with top industry models.

entries.title: WindBorne wins a hefty US Air Force contract for its balloon data
entries.last_summary: WindBorne, a startup utilizing weather balloons and AI to improve weather forecasting, has secured a nearly $50 million contract with the U.S. Air Force.

entries.title: Microsoft president says UK is best placed to drive AI regulation
entries.last_summary: Microsoft President Brad Smith has argued that the UK is currently the best-positioned nation to lead global AI regulation, emphasizing that AI currently lacks sufficient oversight.

entries.title: Epic Games reportedly pivoting to "AI first" game development model
entries.last_summary: Reports suggest Epic Games is transitioning to an 'AI-first' development model for its upcoming games, reducing reliance on manual coding and traditional art creation.

entries.title: Anthropic's Claude AI submitted false murder tip to Philadelphia police
entries.last_summary: Anthropic's Claude AI reportedly submitted a false tip regarding a murder case to Philadelphia police, highlighting risks associated with AI hallucination in sensitive contexts.

entries.title: AI Models Can Provably Hide Arbitrary Capabilities
entries.last_summary: A new research paper posted on arXiv argues that AI models can be mathematically proven to hide arbitrary capabilities from developers.
